verdict.rationale: Plaid documents a no-code visual workflow editor for configuring Identity Verification, not natural-language command operation, but a probe confirms Plaid has an official MCP server (plaid.com/docs/resources/mcp/) which could allow AI agents to invoke Plaid APIs including IDV via natural language. There is no direct evidence that this MCP server specifically exposes Identity Verification actions or that end-users can operate IDV flows via NL commands. missing for 10: IDV-specific MCP tool documentation, examples of natural-language driven verification commands, independent confirmation of agentic usage.
